mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase above 6.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 6.5, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a weakening housing market that reduces consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of instances when both RSAFS and HOUST decline from their previous month's value, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A regime of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) combined with elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 235) indicates supply chain disruptions and cost-push inflation, reducing corporate profit margins and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: supply chain disruption and cost-push inflation
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100 and CPIAUCSL > 235, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI index level above 235 signals persistent inflationary pressures that may prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 235, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: The level of non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS > 100) consistently indicates a strong labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of instances, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime with strong consumer spending (RSAFS > 400000) and high housing starts (HOUST > 1000), the economy is overheating, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS > 400000 and HOUST > 1000, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates a contraction in supply and monetary tightening, which together lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO declines and FEDFUNDS rises, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.
